scope.domain: all 82 questions for D1, D2, D4, D8, and S1
scope.fallback_disposition: inactive; activating the frozen 41-question fallback requires a new pre-measurement pins artifact. If activated, D4 and D8 use the 41-question domain and S1 restricts both b8 and b2 to that same domain. The common full-question draw matrix is retained and normalized within each subset world; no separate subset bootstrap is allowed.

estimands.sign: positive means more error in the first named condition

aggregation.contrast_support: match the two arms on the exact condition-free slot identity. Context-ineligible slots are omitted from both arms and are never coded INVALID. Zero support for any required question x judge x debater stratum fails closed.
aggregation.weighting: within each question x judge x debater x condition average matched slots, then equal debater weights, equal judge weights, and equal question weights
aggregation.mirror_rule: retain and equally average both rendered sides in every primary and S1 estimate. A terminal cell counts wrong and its independently completed partner remains in the strict primary. Exclude the whole affected mirror unit only from paired-position diagnostics.
aggregation.replicate_translation: The protocol phrase 'replicate index 1 per (transcript, side)' is one-based prose. The plan is zero-based and folds side into replicate_index. Under configuration A, plan indices 0 and 1 decode to (side 0, within-side replicate 0) and (side 1, within-side replicate 0). The sensitivity therefore pins within_side_replicate = 0 and retains both sides; filtering global replicate_index == 1 is prohibited.

invalid_policy.primary: strict INVALID, including a terminal INVALID, counts wrong
invalid_policy.principal_valid_only_sensitivity: for each contrast separately, drop a matched slot from both arms when either arm is strict INVALID; retain the opposite mirror side and every other supported slot
invalid_policy.descriptive_all_invalid_scenarios: for D1, D2, D4, D8, and S1, report all-INVALID-correct and all-INVALID-wrong scenario estimates and type-7 percentile intervals using the common question-cluster draws; these are descriptive and have no p-values
invalid_policy.invalid_count_strata: report every budget x named judge x zero-based folded replicate block, including explicit zero-count strata
invalid_policy.exclusion_admission: bare terminal or context-ineligible key arrays are not admissible for confirmatory output. Until a production finalization artifact validates terminal evidence and stop bounds, the frozen context-blocklist hash, and the exact partition, any nonempty exclusion list fails closed.
invalid_policy.judgment_tolerant_parser: none; no alternative or repaired judgment parse is analyzed
invalid_policy.capability_anchor: the frozen syntax-only parser ^ANSWER: ([AB])\.?$ after whitespace stripping is primary for capability anchors; the exact no-period parser is a sensitivity. With the observed tolerant tie, the capability slope is not estimable because anchor-score spread is zero. Any strict-anchor two-judge slope is estimate-and-plot only with no p-value.

source.closeout_evidence: Capability anchors (48 held-out per judge): Qwen 47/48 strict and tolerant (97.9%). Llama 47/48 tolerant (97.9%), 33/48 strict (68.8%); the strict-parse shortfall is format compliance, not knowledge, consistent with phase-2 behavior.

analysis.tolerant: zero anchor-score spread; slope is not estimable and no interval or p-value is reported
analysis.strict: estimate-and-plot-only sensitivity using the same D8 point estimate and common question-cluster bootstrap draws; report a descriptive type-7 percentile 95% interval and no p-value
analysis.anchor_treatment: scores are fixed across bootstrap draws
analysis.slope_unit: D8 error-rate difference per 1.0 anchor-score proportion

bootstrap.prng: CPython random.Random Mersenne Twister; randrange over sorted question IDs; worlds iterated in sorted order; Python version recorded in the result artifact
bootstrap.draw: independently within each world, draw that world's observed number of questions with replacement. A draw is one question-multiplicity vector.
bootstrap.common_draws: one immutable draw sequence is shared by D1, D2, D4, D8, S1, all valid-only sensitivities, all-INVALID-correct and all-INVALID-wrong scenarios, every endpoint-specific descriptive, and the sup-t band
bootstrap.draw_matrix_serialization: JSON array of multiplicity objects with keys sorted, separators ',' and ':', ASCII encoding; SHA-256 recorded
bootstrap.fallback_zero_support_preflight: PASS: all 10,000 frozen draws were checked against the frozen 41-question subset (carath_norn 14, selvarath 14, vethun_sarak 13); zero draws had zero retained multiplicity in any subset world
bootstrap.domain_normalization: within each world normalize by that draw's multiplicity on the estimand domain, then combine worlds using their fixed question share in that domain
bootstrap.ci: marginal percentile 95% interval using type-7 linear interpolation between order statistics
bootstrap.p_value: p = min(1, 2 * min((1 + count(T <= 0))/(B + 1), (1 + count(T >= 0))/(B + 1))); exact zero is included in both tails
bootstrap.holm: step-down over D1, D2, D4, and D8 only, with monotonicity enforcement and lexicographic estimand-ID tie breaking. S1 is a separate family of one.

sup_t.scope: D1, D2, D4, and D8 only; descriptive and never a significance criterion
sup_t.standard_error: sample standard deviation of the B bootstrap estimates using denominator B - 1
sup_t.maximum: for draw r, max_j abs(T_j(r) - point_j) / se_j
sup_t.critical_value: type-7 95th percentile of the B maxima
sup_t.band: point_j plus or minus critical_value * se_j
sup_t.zero_se: if se_j is zero and every draw is within 1e-15 of the point estimate, its maximum component is zero and its band is [point, point]; otherwise fail closed

rounding.computation: IEEE-754 binary64 with no intermediate rounding; all tests and decisions use unrounded values
rounding.display_effects: percentage points to 3 decimal places using Decimal(str(value)) and ROUND_HALF_EVEN
rounding.display_p_values: 6 decimal places using Decimal(str(value)) and ROUND_HALF_EVEN

reporting.pooled_confirmatory_claim: the equal-weight fixed roster of the two exact Together serverless model endpoints only
reporting.per_judge: always report D1, D2, D4, D8, and S1 separately for each named endpoint with the same common draws and marginal intervals; these are descriptive and receive no p-values or Holm claims
reporting.invalid_descriptives: report all-INVALID-correct and all-INVALID-wrong scenarios plus every budget x judge x replicate-block INVALID count stratum, including zeros; no scenario p-values or confirmatory claims
non_claims: No conclusion generalizes to model scale, frontier models, or a population of possible judges.
The sup-t band cannot declare or deny significance.
The capability slope has no inferential p-value with this two-judge roster.

integrity.input: record the main result-store SHA-256, protocol hash, pins hash, engine commit, exact partition count, and any terminal or context-ineligible key artifact hashes
integrity.engine_source: record the raw analysis-engine SHA-256 and repository HEAD separately; report an engine_git_commit only when the engine path is clean and tracked at that HEAD
integrity.question_bank: derive the exact 82 main IDs through the protocol-bound phase-2 references, record their canonical SHA-256, the protocol question-bank bundle SHA-256, and the canonical SHA-256 of the projected 82 source rows
integrity.exclusion_admission: nonempty terminal or context-ineligible key artifacts are a launch blocker until a future production finalization/admission artifact validates their evidence, bounds, hashes, and partition
integrity.outcome_derivation: derive the correct A/B position from the rendered prompt and frozen question bank; stored correctness is a cross-check only
integrity.dry_run: synthetic outcomes must recover hand-computed D1, D2, D4, D8, and S1; preserve world totals and common draws; exercise strict INVALID, valid-only support, mirror pairing, Holm, sup-t, endpoint weighting, and zero-support failures before any main outcome is read
integrity.freeze: after main outcomes exist, no change to B, seed, draw mechanics, domains, support, quantiles, p-values, Holm, sup-t, rounding, or claim roles
